axioms.purpose: Specify whether the relation is order-sensitive and define legal operand ordering.
axioms.statement: The SymmetryConditionRelation is well-formed only when its left operand is BoundedSymmetry and its right operand is UnboundedSymmetry.
axioms.well_formed_rule: WellFormed(a | b) iff TypeOf(a) = BoundedSymmetry and TypeOf(b) = UnboundedSymmetry

axioms.purpose: Specify admissible operand types and required type validation.
axioms.statement: The relation admits exactly a BoundedSymmetry left operand and an UnboundedSymmetry right operand; a generic SymmetryCondition is not silently coerced into either subtype.
axioms.type_rule: Admissible(a | b) iff TypeOf(a) = BoundedSymmetry and TypeOf(b) = UnboundedSymmetry

axioms.purpose: Define identity behavior if an identity exists.
axioms.statement: No identity element is applicable to the typed SymmetryConditionRelation; identity is not an operator-local property of |.

axioms.purpose: Define when equivalent operands may be substituted.
axioms.statement: No nontrivial operand substitution rule is currently admissible for |. Only canonical self-reference and governed alias normalization are allowed; general substitution requires a typed equivalence relation and relation congruence.

axioms.purpose: Define relation composition and closure rules.
Determine whether closure over SymmetryCondition holds.
Define invalid operand combinations and required failure results.
Require identical outputs for identical admissible inputs.
Explicitly prove, reject, or mark associativity inapplicable.
Explicitly prove, reject, or mark commutativity inapplicable.
Specify the complete admissible input domain.
Define compatibility requirements for downstream projection operators.
